# Install LaunchAgent

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `launchd.install` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/launchd.yaml` |
| Tags | launchd, lifecycle |

Copies the rendered `.plist` into `~/Library/LaunchAgents/` and
bootstraps it into the user GUI domain so launchd manages it. Idempotent
against a previously installed copy.
